A frog’s field guide

Bring home as many coins as you can in 60 seconds.

  1. Hop, one pad at a time.Use the arrow keys, WASD, or the on-screen arrows. Each press moves one space.
  2. Follow the gold.Each coin is worth 10 points. New coins appear as you collect them.
  3. Look before you leap.Water gaps and moving red beetles cost a life. You return to the starting pad with a brief protective ring.

The top and bottom rows are beetle-free. Take a breath, then plan your next hop.

Press P or Esc to pause. Opening this guide or leaving the tab also pauses your round. Sound starts off; turn it on anytime.
